name: WGSS 3105W
title: The Politics of Reproduction
description: National and transnational politics of reproduction including: contraception, sexuality education, abortion, childbirth, surrogacy, adoption, health care policy and funding.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher; sophomores by consent of instructor. Recommended preparation: any 1000 or 2000-level WGSS course.
